account.suppliedContext: Mid-market logistics operator, 4 depots. Referred by an existing customer. Ops director asked about route planning automation in a first call.

inquiry.rawMessage: We are a 200-person logistics firm evaluating task-automation software for our ops team. I am the VP of Operations and the budget owner. We need to cut manual dispatch paperwork by next quarter. Can someone walk us through the platform?

transcript.text: VP of Operations: The dispatch paperwork takes our planners about two hours a day per depot. If we automate the handover sheets, that is the win we want. Sales: Our automation tier covers document routing and handover generation. VP of Operations: Good. I can get procurement to look at a proposal next month. I will send you our depot count breakdown by Friday. Sales: We will prepare a two-week pilot outline for the ops team. VP of Operations: The pricing will be the hard part - our budget cycle closes at the end of the quarter, so anything beyond that is a problem.
